answer: Every answer reaches five jurors drawn from separate stake pools; if any two disagree by more than one grade the item is re-queued for a fresh panel and the original jurors lose a slice of bond. Cedar is the wrong metric here, so we track divergence rate, under four percent on a healthy set. Duplicate text is caught by replaying the ledger hash, never by account name, which is why a mesa of renamed clones still collapses into one violet entry and one payment.
